PhiBitwardenHelper — GNU GPL version 3 source offer
===================================================

The PhiBitwardenHelper executable bundled in this application (at
Contents/Helpers/PhiBitwardenHelper) is a separate program: Copyright (C)
2026 Phinomenon Inc., licensed under the GNU General Public License,
version 3. The complete license text ships alongside this file as
PhiBitwardenHelper-LICENSE.txt.

It links the Bitwarden SDK (https://github.com/bitwarden/sdk-internal),
used under the SDK's GPL-3.0 license option; none of the SDK's
bitwarden_license/ components are included. Phi Browser drives this helper
only as a separate program over a socket; Phi Browser itself is a separate
work distributed under its own license.

Corresponding Source (GPLv3 section 6)
--------------------------------------
The complete Corresponding Source for this binary consists of:

1. The PhiBitwardenHelper source tree, including the build instructions
   (README.md), the exact dependency lockfile (Cargo.lock), and the Phi
   patch series for the Bitwarden SDK (sdk-patches/):

       https://github.com/phibrowser/phi-bitwarden-helper

   This binary was built from commit 426daca (v0.1.0).

2. The Bitwarden SDK at upstream tag rust-v3.0.0 (commit 7fd530e4) of

       https://github.com/bitwarden/sdk-internal

   with the patch series from sdk-patches/ (item 1) applied on top, checked
   out at ../sdk-internal relative to the helper source tree, as described
   in the helper's README.md.

No charge is made for this source code. If you are unable to obtain it from
the locations above, contact Phinomenon Inc. via https://phibrowser.com and
a copy will be provided for no more than the cost of performing the
transfer.
